channel.title: Lesotho - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Lesotho, every source cited.

item.title: Lebona Lephema considers new party after RFP leadership bid fails
item.description: Business tycoon Lebona Lephema may form a new political party if his attempt to unseat Nthomeng Majara as RFP deputy leader fails.

item.title: Mafeteng Hospital sued for M2 million over alleged negligence
item.description: A patient claims he received no medical attention for seven days after a stomach operation in December 2024.

item.title: Lesotho to chair SADC security organ
item.description: Prime Minister Sam Matekane's election follows a decade of regional scrutiny for instability.

item.title: Likuena coach warns of player fitness slump
item.description: Bob Mafoso reports aerobic fitness has dropped significantly ahead of November AFCON qualifiers.
